privacy.title: Privacy (GDPR)
privacy.noOperatorBody: No separate operator details are configured for this instance. The application processes circuits exclusively locally in your browser without transmitting personal data to an application server.
privacy.localBodyBeforeCode: Circuits and simulations run exclusively in your browser's memory; project files remain local. Only local app settings (e.g. optional access key) are stored in
privacy.cookiesBody: No tracking or analytics services, user accounts, or server databases are used.
privacy.remoteMcpBody: Only when manually enabled is a connection established to the stateless relay. Ephemeral session IDs exist exclusively in RAM and are deleted when the session ends.
privacy.hostingDefault: Provided according to the operator's server configuration.
privacy.hostingStaticDefault: Static hosting (purely client-side execution in the browser).
privacy.rightsBody: Where personal data is processed, you have rights under Art. 15 et seq. GDPR to access, rectification, erasure, and to lodge a complaint with a competent supervisory authority.

property.soundInvalidFrequency: Please enter a valid frequency between {{min}} and {{max}} Hz.
property.synthesizerPinHint: Inputs: F = 8-bit frequency (0/128 mute, 1..127 & 129..255 MIDI notes ignoring bit 7), V = 8-bit volume (0..255), E = 1-bit enable.
property.pitchTableHint: Bit 7 of the 8-bit frequency input is ignored: values 128..255 mirror 0..127. In noise mode, the pitch value controls the noise bandpass frequency.
property.enableSideHint: Position of the enable control input: from bottom (Tri-State 1) or from top (Tri-State 2).

property.shortcutHint: Focus the field and press desired key (optionally with Ctrl/Alt/Shift).
property.valueHexHint: Hexadecimal input without prefix ("0x" is prepended automatically). Required.
property.jamNotationHint: Short label on the sub-circuit symbol (up to 2 chars left/right, 4 chars top/bottom; fallback: pin name).

property.splitterHintBranch_other: Split bus: splits a {{totalBits}}-bit bus into {{count}} branches of {{pinBitText}} each.
property.splitterHintBundle_one: Combine bus: merges {{count}} single signal of {{pinBitText}} into a {{totalBits}}-bit bus.

property.sensorInvalidManualHex: Invalid hexadecimal value (max. 8 hex digits 0–9, A–F).
property.displayShapeHint: The "Display" shape becomes available once the circuit contains at least one display component (LED, 7-Segment, LED Matrix).
property.showLabelAboveHint: Recommended for the "Display" shape so the title is not clipped or covered by controls.
property.displayMarginHint: Expands display sub-circuits by 1 grid unit per selected direction so pin labels are not obscured.
property.graphicalOrderHint: Orders pins automatically by their position in the schematic (index = 0). Use "<" and ">" to define a fixed order.
